claims.claim: Israeli capital gains tax on securities: 25% for individuals (Section 91(b)(1)), 30% where the seller is a 10%-or-more (substantial) shareholder (Section 91(b)(2)), corporate rate (23%) for Israeli companies (Section 126(a)); plus a separate surtax (mas yesef, Section 121B) of up to 5% (3% on all-source income, plus a further 2% from 2025 on capital-source income) above an annually indexed threshold of ILS 721,560 in 2026.
claims.raw_snippet: The real gain, if any, realised upon the sale of shares purchased on or after 1 January 2003 is generally taxed at a rate of 25% for individuals. This rate is increased to 30% where the seller was a 10% or more shareholder at the date of sale or during any of the 12 months preceding the sale

claims.claim: Israeli dividend tax: 25% generally, 30% in the case of a 10%-or-more (substantial) shareholder, withheld at source (nikui b'makor). The surtax (mas yesef) applies separately to income above the annual threshold. Foreign-brokerage holders self-report on Form 1322 (capital gains) and Form 1301 (annual return). Israel has no annual tax-free capital-gains allowance.
claims.raw_snippet: Dividends shall generally be subject to tax at the rate of 25% (or 30% in the case of a 10% or more shareholder).

claims.claim: For securities gains on which full Israeli tax was NOT withheld at source (a foreign brokerage, or an approved withholding exemption), an Israeli resident must file a semi-annual report and pay a capital-gains advance (mikdama) by 31 July and 31 January for gains realized in the preceding six months. Late payment accrues CPI linkage and interest.
claims.raw_snippet: נקבעה למועדים 31 ביולי ו-31 בינואר של כל שנת מס, בשל מימוש ניירות ערך ב- 6 החודשים שקדמו לחודש שבו חל יום הדיווח.

claims.claim: TASE Data Hub access is by API Key issued in the TASE Developers' Portal: register, create an App, then '+Generate Credential' to be assigned an API Key, which you supply via 'Authorize' on the product page. Rate limit 10 requests per 2 seconds with HTTP 429 on excess. Some data products are paid and need commercial approval before activation. Entry point https://www.tase.co.il/he/content/products_lobby/data_services; the older https://openapi.tase.co.il/tase/prod/ and https://datahub.tase.co.il/ addresses redirect to it, and https://openapigw.tase.co.il/tase/prod is bot-filtered.
claims.raw_snippet: Once the app has been set up, a screen will pop up with the app's details. To create an API Key, click on '+Generate Credential' then assign a name of your choice to the credential and click on 'Generate'.
claims.source_note: SOURCE REPLACED AND CLAIM NARROWED 2026-08-10. The former entry cited the bare homepage https://datahub.tase.co.il/ (which now 302-redirects to the TASE data-services lobby) for an OAuth2 client-credentials flow. This official TASE Data Hub API guide, linked from https://www.tase.co.il/he/content/products_lobby/data_services, documents API-Key authentication and does not mention OAuth2 or a token endpoint anywhere. The old developer-portal URL https://openapi.tase.co.il/tase/prod/ also now redirects to that lobby, and openapigw.tase.co.il is behind Incapsula (503 to both curl and a real browser), so the previously documented token endpoint could not be confirmed either way. The skill body now documents the API-Key flow and flags the OAuth2 endpoint as legacy and unverified.

claims.claim: The Israeli surtax (mas yesef) threshold is ILS 721,560 in 2026, and is indexed annually. A 3% surtax applies to total taxable income above the threshold; from 2025 a further 2% applies to the capital-source part above it.
claims.raw_snippet: As of 2025, the portion of an individual's taxable annual income from capital sources (e.g. capital gains, real estate appreciation, dividends, interest, CPI linkage differentials, rental income, passive royalties) exceeding a certain threshold (ILS 721,560 in 2026) is subject to an additional surtax of 2%. This is in addition to 3% surtax on an individual's annual taxable income from all sources exceeding a certain threshold (ILS 721,560 in 2026).
